completeDateTime.description: The date, time, date time or other date time value for a complete specified period of time expressed as a specific month, a specific week, etc.

continuousIndicator.description: The indication of whether or not this specified period is continuous.

dayQuantity.description: The number of days in this specified period.

description.description: A textual description of this specified period of time.

duration.description: A duration, expressed as text, for this specified period.

durationMeasure.description: A measure of the length of time for this specified time period such as hours, days, weeks, months, years.

endDateTime.description: The date, time, date time or other date time value for the end of this specified period of time.

endDayOfWeekCode.description: The code specifying the end day of the week for this specified period.

identifier.description: The unique identifier of this specified period.

inclusiveIndicator.description: The indication of whether or not the start and end dates are included in this specified period.

maximumDurationMeasure.description: The measure of the maximum length of time for this specified period, such as hours, days, weeks, months, years.

minimumDurationMeasure.description: The measure of the minimum length of time for this specified period, such as hours, days, weeks, months, years.

name.description: A name, expressed as text, of this specified period.

nightQuantity.description: The number of nights in this specified period.

openIndicator.description: The indication of whether or not an entity is open during this specified period.

purposeCode.description: The code specifying the purpose of this specified period.

seasonCode.description: The code specifying the season for this specified period.

sequenceNumeric.description: A sequence number for this specified period.

startDateFlexibilityCode.description: The code specifying the flexibility of the start date of this specified period.

startDateTime.description: The date, time, date time or other date time value for the start of this specified period of time.

startDayOfWeekCode.description: The code specifying the start day of the week for this specified period.

typeCode.description: The code specifying the type of specified period.
